notes: Release date: official news sidebar 'DeepSeek-V3.2 正式版发布 2025/12/01', slug news251201, and HuggingFace deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2 createdAt 2025-12-01T02:34:49Z all agree. GA of the V3.2 line two months after V3.2-Exp (user feedback found no scenario where Exp was significantly worse than V3.1-Terminus, validating DSA). All numeric benchmark scores render inside three webp images (benchmark.webp hero, benchmark_table_cn.webp = Table 1 with per-cell token consumption, agent_benchmark.webp = Table 2); all printed cells were re-read from the archived images on 2026-09-01 and are enumerated as evidence rows, including the full V3.2-Speciale column of Table 1 and the hero-chart-only SWE Verified / Terminal-Bench 2.0 values. Cross-vendor consistency: the V3.2-Thinking values read from Table 1 (HLE 25.1, GPQA-D 82.4, HMMT Nov 90.2, IMOAnswerBench 78.3, LiveCodeBench 83.3) match the DeepSeek-V3.2 competitor columns printed in GLM-4.7/GLM-5/GLM-5.1 and Kimi K2.5 pages - four independent renderings agree. Agent training data synthesis disclosed: 1800+ environments, 85,000+ complex instructions, no tool-specific training for the agent benchmarks (generalization claim). V3.2-Speciale: IMO 2025 / CMO 2025 / ICPC World Finals 2025 / IOI 2025 gold medals (ICPC = 2nd place human level, IOI = 10th); temporary API endpoint v3.2_speciale_expires_on_20251215; thinking-only, max output 128K default. Thinking-mode tool calling API semantics documented (reasoning_content must be replayed).
